verdict.rationale: RudderStack's own docs cover each part of the story. Reverse ETL sources sync data from your warehouse, data lake, or database (rudderstack-docs-36). Audiences are built on warehouse sources and activated downstream (rudderstack-docs-27, rudderstack-docs-38). Profiles lets you declare entities in version-controlled YAML that generate warehouse-native SQL (rudderstack-docs-35). Warehouse-activation pipelines send data to 200+ SaaS tools without re-collecting it (rudderstack-docs-59). The evidence is mostly one-line marketing and overview claims, not in-depth docs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on defining arbitrary SQL/dbt models over existing tables, sync scheduling and modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse activation.
